### 1. Product & Applicant Context
• **Product**: Led Bulb
• **Manufacturing Origin**: India (Domestic Manufacturing)
• **Applicable Standard**: **IS 16102 (Part 1) : 2012**
• **Regulatory Scheme**: **MeitY Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) & DPIIT QCO**

### 2. Likely Certification Route & Applicability Conditions
• **Regulatory Route**: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS / Scheme II) under MeitY and DPIIT Quality Control Orders.
• **Conditions**: Unlike Scheme I, CRS does not require an upfront physical factory audit for domestic applicants. Registration is granted based on passing test reports from an accredited, BIS-recognized testing laboratory in India.
• **Applicability Boundary**: Covers self-ballasted lamps and IT/electronic equipment meeting standard voltage and wattage scopes.

### 3. Required Document Checklist
**Mandatory Application Documents:**
1. **Laboratory Test Report**: Complete safety test report issued by an accredited/BIS-recognized laboratory (NABL/LRS) within 90 days of online application submission.
2. **Form-1 Application**: System-generated application form submitted via the official BIS CRS portal.
3. **Proof of Manufacturing Premises**: Factory registration, GST registration, or municipal manufacturing license establishing actual production operations.
4. **Brand / Trademark Ownership**: Trademark registration certificate. If applying on behalf of a brand owner, an official Trademark Authorization Form is mandatory.
5. **Statutory Undertaking & Affidavit**: Undertaking confirming compliance to Indian Standards and model series declarations.
6. **Signatory KYC**: PAN / Aadhaar / Passport of the authorized signatory along with board authorization.

**Conditional / If Applicable:**
• *Foreign Manufacturers*: Nomination and agreement for Authorized Indian Representative (AIR) residing in India.
• *Multiple Models*: Series approval justification matrix if covering secondary models under one base model test report.
• *MSME / Udyam Registration*: Required if applying for statutory fee concessions.

### 4. Testing & Laboratory Requirements
• **Governing Standard**: IS 16102 (Part 1) : 2012 (Safety of Self-Ballasted LED-Lamps).
• **Key Safety Parameters**:
  - **Insulation Resistance & Electric Strength (Clause 8)**: Insulation resistance >= 4.0 Megohms at 500V DC; electric strength withstand of 1500V AC rms for 1 minute.
  - **Cap Torque Retention (Clause 9)**: Minimum mechanical torque resistance of 3.0 Nm for B22d and E27 caps (1.15 Nm for E14).
  - **Creepage & Clearance (Clause 12)**: Minimum creepage distance of 3.0mm and clearance distance of 2.5mm.
• **Testing Location**: Must be carried out at a BIS-recognized / NABL accredited Indian testing laboratory.

### 5. Step-by-Step Application Procedure
1. **Step 1 (Sample Testing)**: Send product samples to a BIS-recognized testing laboratory for testing under IS 16102 (Part 1) : 2012. Receive passing test report.
2. **Step 2 (CRS Portal Registration)**: Create user profile on the official [BIS CRS Portal](https://www.crsbis.in/BIS/).
3. **Step 3 (Dossier & Report Upload)**: Submit Form-1, attach laboratory test report (issued within 90 days), and upload factory proof and brand authorizations.
4. **Step 4 (Statutory Fee Payment)**: Pay application fee (₹1,000) and processing fee (₹50,000 for 2-year tenure) via payment gateway.
5. **Step 5 (BIS Scrutiny)**: Scrutiny of test reports and technical dossier by BIS CRS officers.
6. **Step 6 (Grant of Registration)**: BIS issues the Registration Number (R-number) authorizing use of the Standard Mark on approved product packaging.

• [Official BIS Know Your Standards Portal](https://www.services.bis.gov.in)

### 1. Product & Applicant Context
• **Product**: Led Bulb
• **Manufacturing Origin**: India (Domestic Manufacturing)
• **Applicable Standard**: **IS 16102 (Part 1) : 2012**
• **Regulatory Scheme**: **MeitY Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) & DPIIT QCO**

### 2. Likely Certification Route & Applicability Conditions
• **Regulatory Route**: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS / Scheme II) under MeitY and DPIIT Quality Control Orders.
• **Conditions**: Unlike Scheme I, CRS does not require an upfront physical factory audit for domestic applicants. Registration is granted based on passing test reports from an accredited, BIS-recognized testing laboratory in India.
• **Applicability Boundary**: Covers self-ballasted lamps and IT/electronic equipment meeting standard voltage and wattage scopes.

### 3. Required Document Checklist
**Mandatory Application Documents:**
1. **Laboratory Test Report**: Complete safety test report issued by an accredited/BIS-recognized laboratory (NABL/LRS) within 90 days of online application submission.
2. **Form-1 Application**: System-generated application form submitted via the official BIS CRS portal.
3. **Proof of Manufacturing Premises**: Factory registration, GST registration, or municipal manufacturing license establishing actual production operations.
4. **Brand / Trademark Ownership**: Trademark registration certificate. If applying on behalf of a brand owner, an official Trademark Authorization Form is mandatory.
5. **Statutory Undertaking & Affidavit**: Undertaking confirming compliance to Indian Standards and model series declarations.
6. **Signatory KYC**: PAN / Aadhaar / Passport of the authorized signatory along with board authorization.

**Conditional / If Applicable:**
• *Foreign Manufacturers*: Nomination and agreement for Authorized Indian Representative (AIR) residing in India.
• *Multiple Models*: Series approval justification matrix if covering secondary models under one base model test report.
• *MSME / Udyam Registration*: Required if applying for statutory fee concessions.

### 4. Testing & Laboratory Requirements
• **Governing Standard**: IS 16102 (Part 1) : 2012 (Safety of Self-Ballasted LED-Lamps).
• **Key Safety Parameters**:
  - **Insulation Resistance & Electric Strength (Clause 8)**: Insulation resistance >= 4.0 Megohms at 500V DC; electric strength withstand of 1500V AC rms for 1 minute.
  - **Cap Torque Retention (Clause 9)**: Minimum mechanical torque resistance of 3.0 Nm for B22d and E27 caps (1.15 Nm for E14).
  - **Creepage & Clearance (Clause 12)**: Minimum creepage distance of 3.0mm and clearance distance of 2.5mm.
• **Testing Location**: Must be carried out at a BIS-recognized / NABL accredited Indian testing laboratory.

### 5. Step-by-Step Application Procedure
1. **Step 1 (Sample Testing)**: Send product samples to a BIS-recognized testing laboratory for testing under IS 16102 (Part 1) : 2012. Receive passing test report.
2. **Step 2 (CRS Portal Registration)**: Create user profile on the official [BIS CRS Portal](https://www.crsbis.in/BIS/).
3. **Step 3 (Dossier & Report Upload)**: Submit Form-1, attach laboratory test report (issued within 90 days), and upload factory proof and brand authorizations.
4. **Step 4 (Statutory Fee Payment)**: Pay application fee (₹1,000) and processing fee (₹50,000 for 2-year tenure) via payment gateway.
5. **Step 5 (BIS Scrutiny)**: Scrutiny of test reports and technical dossier by BIS CRS officers.
6. **Step 6 (Grant of Registration)**: BIS issues the Registration Number (R-number) authorizing use of the Standard Mark on approved product packaging.

• [Official BIS Know Your Standards Portal](https://www.services.bis.gov.in)
